# Topic A — Fitting & Diagnosing a Multiple Regression


## Q1 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Predict median home value (medv, $1000s) from rooms (rm), lower-status share (lstat) and pupil-teacher ratio (ptratio).

```{r q1-data, eval=TRUE}
library(MASS)      # Boston housing data
library(car)       # vif()
```

```{r q1-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
fit <- lm(medv ~ rm + lstat + ptratio, data = Boston)
summary(fit)
round(coef(fit), 4)
# rm: one extra room is linked to about $4,500 more, holding lstat and ptratio fixed.
```

# Topic B — Collinearity, Polynomials, Categories & Interaction


## Q6 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Check the VIF of a model with correlated predictors.

```{r q6-data, eval=TRUE}
library(MASS)      # Boston housing data
library(car)       # vif()
```

```{r q6-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
fit_big <- lm(medv ~ rm + lstat + ptratio + tax + rad + nox, data = Boston)
v <- vif(fit_big)
round(v, 2)
round(cor(Boston$tax, Boston$rad), 3)      # tax and rad move together
```

# Topic C — Dates & Dummy Variables


## Q11 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Turn date strings into Date objects and extract useful predictors (made-up sales data).

```{r q11-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
set.seed(11)
day <- seq(as.Date("2025-01-01"), as.Date("2025-12-31"), by = "day")
sales <- data.frame(date = day,
                    units = round(200 + 30 * sin(2 * pi * as.numeric(format(day, "%j")) / 365) +
                                  25 * (weekdays(day) %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday")) + rnorm(length(day), 0, 10)))
sales$month <- factor(format(sales$date, "%m"))
sales$weekend <- weekdays(sales$date) %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday")
head(sales, 3)
round(tapply(sales$units, sales$weekend, mean), 2)
```

# Topic D — Variable Selection & Evaluation


## Q16 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Evaluate a model on data it has not seen.

```{r q16-data, eval=TRUE}
library(MASS)      # Boston housing data
library(car)       # vif()
```

```{r q16-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
set.seed(16)
idx <- sample(nrow(Boston), round(0.7 * nrow(Boston)))
train <- Boston[idx, ]; test <- Boston[-idx, ]
m <- lm(medv ~ rm + lstat + ptratio, data = train)
rmse <- function(obs, pred) sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2))
round(c(train = rmse(train$medv, fitted(m)), test = rmse(test$medv, predict(m, test))), 3)
```
